summary: City-level /api/search feature fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass (stop-level regression + city-to-city + mixed mode + 400 error branches). Frontend Playwright: home city picker → 🏙 icon + 'Any stop · Kuala Lumpur' text visible, FROM chip renders 'Kuala Lumpur / Any stop · 4 options', TO chip renders 'Singapore / Any stop · 2 options', search URL emits from_city=Kuala+Lumpur&to_city=Singapore (NOT from=/to=), city-mode results page renders 'Any stop · <city>' label + schedule cards + Select button. Stop-level regression: TBS→<terminal> picks emit from=<uuid>&to=<uuid> (no from_city/to_city), empty-state try-tomorrow link preserves stop mode. City-mode results actually aggregate more than a single pair (verified via API assertion).

integration_issues.issue: Top 'MODIFY SEARCH' link (SearchResults.jsx:59) and bottom 'Back to Search' link (SearchResults.jsx:194) hardcode only from/to terminal ids. When user arrived via city mode (from_city/to_city), these links produce /?from=&to=&... which loses the city selection and lands them on a blank Home form. Home.jsx prefill useEffect DOES handle from_city/to_city — the fix is just to include those params in the back-link URLs.

action_items: MINOR: Fix Modify-Search / Back-to-Search links in SearchResults.jsx (lines 59 & 194) to also include from_city/to_city when in city mode — otherwise city-mode users lose their selection on going back to Home.

NOTE (spec vs code): Review request referenced data-testid 'home-from-select-city-kuala-lumpur' and 'home-from-select-opt-TBS'. Actual code uses 'from-terminal-city-kuala-lumpur' and 'from-terminal-opt-TBS' (Home.jsx passes testId='from-terminal' / 'to-terminal'). Not a bug — the actual test-ids are consistent and testable — but flagging in case main agent intended to rename them.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:512-610 (search_schedules): clean 2-mode implementation. from_ids/to_ids resolved separately from either terminal_id or city, with a graceful fallback for legacy terminals missing is_pickup/is_dropoff fields. Query optimizes to direct equality when single-stop, $in when multi. Post-query enrichment builds from_meta / to_meta correctly with is_city + stop_count for city mode. Seat-availability aggregation is single-round-trip. No _id leaks.
backend/server.py:553 raises HTTPException(400, ...) if from_ids OR to_ids is empty — this correctly covers both 'no params at all' and 'bogus city name' cases (verified with both test cases).

frontend/pages/Home.jsx:158-175 submit handler: sets from_city/to_city OR from/to based on is_city flag — never both. URLSearchParams encodes 'Kuala Lumpur' as 'Kuala+Lumpur' which the backend accepts (Python decodes '+' as space). Verified.

frontend/pages/Home.jsx:134-156 prefill useEffect: correctly reconstructs city-mode chip from from_city/to_city URL params, including stop_count from data.all.filter(...).length. Handles all 4 combinations (from-id/from-city × to-id/to-city).
frontend/pages/SearchResults.jsx:27-39: correctly reads either terminal id OR city from URL and forwards to /api/search with the right param names. Good.
frontend/pages/SearchResults.jsx:59 & 194: Back-link URLs do NOT preserve from_city/to_city (see integration_issues). Small fix.
frontend/pages/SearchResults.jsx:98-119: try-tomorrow link IS mode-aware (checks from vs fromCity, to vs toCity) and preserves whichever mode the user used. Good.
The exclude= prop on TerminalSelect correctly disables the same-city option in the other picker when a city is selected (Home.jsx:79 cityDisabled) — nice UX touch.
code-quality carry-over from iteration_12: server.py is now 3449+ lines. Still recommend splitting into routers.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable test file: /app/backend/tests/test_city_search.py (7 tests, ~1.2s). Key facts: (1) Preview env has 4 KL terminals and 2 SG terminals (stop_count assertions rely on >=1, so safe). (2) Home data-testid pattern is `{testId}-city-{city-lower-hyphen}` and `{testId}-opt-{code}` — NOT `home-from-select-*` as the review-request spec text suggested. (3) City-level search does aggregate real results — verified 1 KL→SG schedule visible on 2026-08-02. (4) URLSearchParams encodes spaces as '+' — backend accepts. (5) Modify-Search back-link bug: minor, doesn't affect this batch's acceptance criteria but user-visible when navigating back from city-mode results. (6) Booking pipeline was NOT re-tested here (main agent explicitly said 'don't test pickup/drop-off selection' — separate batch). Existing regression coverage for the booking flow lives in test_bus_booking_api.py.
